subject: Help in R for removing a layer on plots

messages.author: 357da66c95d49c5f
messages.subject: Help in R for removing a layer on plots
parts:
Hi,

I want to know if there is a way to remove a geom in ggplot2 using R.
For example,

I have the following code:

> p= ggplot(faithful,aes(x=waiting))+geom_histogram(binwidth=1/10)
> p

this will print the histogram. Now I have the following code:

> p+ geom_density(size=1.5, color="green")
> p

this adds a new geom for smooth histogram over the earlier histogram
plot. This will be colored green.

Is there any way to remove the later green colored smooth histogram
geom without overriding it with the density geom ( without any
parameters) or writing histogram geom from scratch?

I think there should be some command to delete a geom if we add it by
mistake.So here i still want to retain the earlier histogram geom but
remove the newer green geom

Thanks.

messages.author: 1d2e006d333c0101
messages.subject: Error with scale_x_date
parts:
Hi All,

I have a data frame ic.df

> head(ic.df)
date variable value
1 1967-01-07 ic_nsa 346000
2 1967-01-14 ic_nsa 334000
3 1967-01-21 ic_nsa 277000
4 1967-01-28 ic_nsa 252000
5 1967-02-04 ic_nsa 274000
6 1967-02-11 ic_nsa 276000

I want to plot data from year 2007 onwards,
> qplot(date, value/1000, data = ic.df, geom = 'line', colour = variable,
group = variable) +
scale_colour_brewer(pal = 'Set1') +
xlim(c(as.Date('2007-01-01'),end))
Error in get(x, envir = this, inherits = inh)(this, ...) :
(list) object cannot be coerced to type 'double'

But the following works
> qplot(date, value/1000, data = ic.df[ic.df$date > as.Date('2007-01-01'),],
geom = 'line', colour = variable, group = variable) +
scale_colour_brewer(pal = 'Set1')

Could any one help me understand what is the error and where I am going
wrong. Thanks in advance for the valuable assistance.

Regards,

Krishna

messages.author: 065110cca96a6373
messages.subject: Re: Help in R for removing a layer on plots
parts:
Hi,

What you want to do is straight forward:

(p <- ggplot(faithful,aes(x=waiting)) + geom_histogram(binwidth=1/10))

p + geom_density(size=1.5, color="green")

## if you don't want the histogram just copy and paste the code you do want
(p <- ggplot(faithful,aes(x=waiting)) + geom_density(size=1.5, color="green"))

The creation of the object is quite fast, it is the rendering that can
be a bit slow, so there is not even a strong argument for "deleting"
over simply recreating from a computational point of view.

Cheers,

Josh

messages.subject: Re: Error with scale_x_date
parts:
Hello Krishna,

Please have a look at the example given in scale_date():

library(ggplot2)
data(economics)
ggplot(economics, aes(date, psavert))+geom_line()

end <- as.Date('2001-12-31')

last_plot() + scale_x_date(lim = c(as.Date("1992-1-1"), end))

i hope this is what you have been looking for.

Cheers,
Swagath Navin
